what: The capture of 7452191 (rotated planes per step, input digests) replayed through both block slots.
outcome: steps 1 and 2 exported bit-for-bit; at step 3 the coupler export differed on every rank, first in the isotopic large-scale rain flux (a2x attribute 39), by up to 1e-5 relative
diagnosis: every contracted input of both blocks hashed as the capture's on every call through step 3 (the replay's digests), so what differed was written by a block and read only outside it: the microphysics driver's wtrc_output_precip fills the water tracers' surface precipitation fields (water_tracer_vars' wtrc_srfpcp_indices, one per precipitation type and tracer set), which no field table sees; a replay left the isotopic large-scale rain at its previous value and the export of that flux differed.  The block now takes those fields from the image's index array as outputs.
disposition: recaptured and replayed as p26-cloud-capture5 and p26-cloud-replay5
